# Golden envelopes of moonpool-rpc protocol version 1 (frame payloads, no
# frame header). Independent of Rust: each line is `name hex`, laid out as
# the `protocol::wire` module docs describe (little-endian fixed-width
# fields). Version 1 is the unreleased layout as it stood after #216 (reply
# streams included). A change to any line is a wire break and needs a new
# protocol version, never a fixture update.
#
# Shared values: incarnation 0x0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f10, call id 7,
# token 3#1, interface 0x6b760001 version 2, method 0x20, schema 1,
# codec 1 (prost), body 0a026869 (prost `string text = 1` = "hi"),
# frame limit 1 MiB.
